verses.1: To David, a song for the Lord: The earth and its wealth belong to God; the people who dwell there also belong to Him.
verses.2: For he has established it on the seas, and he has arranged it along the rivers.
verses.3: Who will ascend to the mountain of Jehovah? Who will rise in his holy place?
verses.4: Clean hands and a pure heart, so that my soul may not be brought into shame, and I may not be deceived by lies.
verses.5: May He receive blessings from Jehovah, and righteousness from the God of salvation.
verses.6: This is the time when those who seek your face will be satisfied, Jacob.
verses.7: Open your doors, and lift up the gates of heaven. Then the King of Glory will come.
verses.8: Who is this king of glory? He is Jehovah, the mighty and powerful king. He is a king who rules over wars.
verses.9: Open your doors, and let the gates of heaven be opened. Then the King of Glory will come in.
verses.10: Who is this king of glory? Jehovah, the Lord of hosts, he is the king of glory.
